findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tours_activities_by_destination, get_tours_activities_by_category, get_product_detail, get_support_guide · Private data: get_support_guide · Public sink: search_tours_activities_by_destination, get_tours_activities_by_category, get_product_detail, get_support_guide · Destructive: get_product_availability, get_support_guide.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tours_activities_by_destination, get_tours_activities_by_category, get_product_detail, get_support_guide · Private data: get_support_guide · Public sink: search_tours_activities_by_destination, get_tours_activities_by_category, get_product_detail, get_support_guide · Destructive: get_product_availability, get_support_guide

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
